analysis.denominator: only trials with A, B, and C all sensitivity-adjudicable under the frozen contract
analysis.exploratory_endpoint: all 24 metadata-eligible triples, reported separately with source-cluster dependence; cannot promote the primary claim
analysis.primary_endpoint: number of source-level sealed trials satisfying the isolated A-B-C event class
analysis.secondary_endpoint: dual-instrument same-filter coincidence status for any B candidate when a paired witness exists

holdout_construction.legacy_pixel_audit: The selected filenames do not occur in the locally preserved 2F-C or 2F-C-R1 runtime artifacts; 2F-D/2F-E metadata mention does not count as pixel inspection.
holdout_construction.pixel_blind_definition: No target-pixel inspection by the 2F-E representative pixel stage or the 2F-F targeted recovery stage. Presence in earlier exact-WCS metadata manifests is allowed and expected.

interpretation_gates.dual_instrument_same_filter_event: High-priority sky-origin transient candidate, still not a tachyon identification.
interpretation_gates.one_or_more_primary_events: Replicated isolated one-exposure point-source motif candidate within a LUCI/Palomar holdout; requires artifact, moving-object, atmosphere and cross-instrument adjudication.
interpretation_gates.zero_primary_events: Negative result for this 9-source metadata-selected LUCI holdout only.

lineage_note: This experiment transfers the preregistration/observer-separation architecture of JANUS Tahyon Traveler to astronomy: metadata target selection is T_target; first pixel read is the observation/materialization boundary. It does not transfer the distributed-system timing anomalies as evidence for astrophysical retrocausality.

paired_instrument_control.definition: For the sealed B time, locate an untouched exposure of the other LUCI instrument at the same src_id and exact same filter string, with |DATE-OBS difference| <= 10 seconds, using metadata only.
paired_instrument_control.use: If the primary B is a candidate, the paired B is an independent same-filter detector witness. It adjudicates sky-origin only when the actual exposure intervals overlap by at least 50 percent of the shorter exposure; otherwise it is contextual only.

pixel_test_contract.B_event_requirement: R1-compatible candidate at the frozen exact sky coordinate
pixel_test_contract.blocked_policy: Any failed frame/sensitivity/HDU-binding gate is UNRESOLVED, never silently counted as absence.
pixel_test_contract.local_sensitivity: unchanged SNR 8 and 12 local injection contract inherited from 2F-F; edge-aware repair only under its already-frozen >=0.995 modeled PSF-retention rule

primary_selection_rule.choose: minimum score per src_id using metadata only
primary_selection_rule.unit: one sealed A-B-C trial per eligible source

purpose: Test a metadata-frozen isolated A->B->C transient motif at previously uninspected LUCI exact-overlap frames for frozen Palomar source coordinates. Timing and coordinates are sealed before target pixels are read.
